# graviteeam_permissions_metadata (Data Source)

Reads Gravitee AM member permission metadata for environments, domains, applications, and protected resources

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graviteeam_permissions_metadata" "environment" {
  kind = "environment_member_permissions"
}

data "graviteeam_permissions_metadata" "domain" {
  kind      = "domain_member_permissions"
  domain_id = graviteeam_domain.example.id
}

data "graviteeam_permissions_metadata" "application" {
  kind           = "application_member_permissions"
  domain_id      = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  application_id = graviteeam_application.example.id
}

data "graviteeam_permissions_metadata" "protected_resource" {
  kind                  = "protected_resource_member_permissions"
  domain_id             = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  protected_resource_id = graviteeam_protected_resource.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) Permission metadata kind. Supported values: application_member_permissions, domain_member_permissions, environment_member_permissions, protected_resource_member_permissions

### Optional

- `application_id` (String) Application ID, required for application_member_permissions
- `domain_id` (String) Domain ID, required for domain, application, and protected resource permission metadata
- `protected_resource_id` (String) Protected resource ID, required for protected_resource_member_permissions

### Read-Only

- `result_json` (String) JSON string containing the permission metadata response
